system.description: acter sheet, representing your Trusty Horse, a unique mount with whom you wish to have a special bond. Your Trusty Horse doesn't normally perform actions. If you wish to have your Trusty Horse perform additional manoeuvres, you do so at the cost of 1 Wind per additional manoeuvre. Your Trusty Horse has a Strength of 6 and a Wind score of (which is higher than other mounts of similar Strength). It may improve its Wind score with the same way Trusty Horse characters recover Wind advances. Any time the Trusty Horse would suffer fatigue, stress, or damage, it may use the owner’s Animal Handling or Ride instead of Experience. Alternately, it loses 1 Wind instead. Enemies may attack it as an action, automatically causing it to lose 1 Wind, with no check needed. When the Trusty Horse runs out of Wind, it becomes Blown and is in danger of dying. Any time your Trusty Horse would lose more Wind while Blown, instead make an Average Animal (2d) Ride (Ag) check or Handle (Fel) check, or purchase +1 maximum Wind for your horse as a permanent advance. If you fail the check, your Trusty Horse dies. Trusty Horse is Swift; it receives a free movement manoeuvre on its turn in addition to the normal manoeuvre all creatures get. The Trusty Horse acts when you act.
